subject: English
passage: Typical paper airplanes usually fly for only a few seconds before crashing due to either air resistance slowing them down or structural weaknesses causing the wings to fold. But aerospace engineer Imani Ochieng and colleagues discovered ways to address these issues, resulting in paper planes that can stay airborne for several minutes. For example, adding small strips of tape along the wing edges creates reinforcement, so a plane with taped edges is able to maintain its structural integrity during flight and thereby resist the folding forces that typically cause crashes.
prompt: Which choice best states the purpose of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?

choices.A: It describes the effects of a process devised by researchers that increases the longevity of an object discussed in the text.
choices.B: It details the circumstances that prompted the research discussed in the text.
choices.C: It presents a reason why the phenomenon discussed in the text that the researchers wanted to avoid will inevitably occur.
choices.D: It mentions a method discussed in the text that researchers plan to investigate in upcoming studies.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer because it describes how the underlined portion of the sentence functions in the text as a whole. The text begins by discussing typical paper airplanes, objects that usually fly for only a few seconds before crashing due to either air resistance or structural weaknesses. The text then goes on to mention work by researchers Imani Ochieng and colleagues, who have discovered how to increase the flight duration of paper planes by modifying their construction. Finally, the underlined portion of the text describes how this process works: since the plane has taped edges, it can maintain structural integrity and resist folding forces. Therefore, the underlined portion of the sentence describes the effects of a process devised by researchers that increases the longevity of an object described in the text.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because the underlined portion of the text does not address why paper planes must eventually crash. Rather, it explains how the flight duration of paper planes can be extended.
